def _parse_range_header(http_range: str, file_size: int) ->list[tuple[int, int]
    ]:
    ranges: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    try:
        units, range_ = http_range.split("=", 1)
    except ValueError:
        raise MalformedRangeHeader()

    units = units.strip().lower()

    if units != "bytes":
        raise MalformedRangeHeader("Only support bytes range")

    range_parts = _RANGE_PATTERN.findall(range_)
    for part in range_parts:
        if part == ("", ""):
            continue
        start_str, end_str = part
        if start_str == "" and end_str != "":
            # suffix-byte-range-spec: -<suffix-length>
            start = file_size - int(end_str)
            end = file_size
        elif start_str != "" and end_str == "":
            # byte-range-spec: <start>- 
            start = int(start_str)
            end = file_size
        elif start_str != "" and end_str != "":
            # byte-range-spec: <start>-<end>
            start = int(start_str)
            end = int(end_str) + 1
        else:
            continue
            
        if start > end:
            raise MalformedRangeHeader("Range header: start must be less than end")
        if start < 0 or end > file_size:
            raise RangeNotSatisfiable(file_size)
            
        ranges.append((start, end))

    if len(ranges) == 0:
        raise MalformedRangeHeader("Range header: range must be requested")

    # Sort ranges by start position
    ranges.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    
    # Merge overlapping ranges
    merged_ranges = []
    for start, end in ranges:
        if not merged_ranges:
            merged_ranges.append((start, end))
        else:
            last_start, last_end = merged_ranges[-1]
            if start <= last_end:
                # Overlapping or adjacent ranges, merge them
                merged_ranges[-1] = (last_start, max(last_end, end))
            else:
                merged_ranges.append((start, end))
    
    return merged_ranges

def generate_multipart(self, ranges: typing.Sequence[tuple[int, int]],
    boundary: str, max_size: int, content_type: str) ->tuple[int, typing.
    Callable[[int, int], bytes]]:
    r"""
    Multipart response headers generator.

    ```
    --{boundary}\n
    Content-Type: {content_type}\n
    Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n
    \n
    ..........content...........\n
    --{boundary}\n
    Content-Type: {content_type}\n
    Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n
    \n
    ..........content...........\n
    --{boundary}--\n
    ```
    """
    boundary_len = len(boundary)
    static_header_part_len = 44 + boundary_len + len(content_type) + len(str(max_size))
    content_length = sum(
        (len(str(start)) + len(str(end - 1)) + static_header_part_len)  # Headers
        + (end - start)  # Content
        for start, end in ranges
    ) + (
        5 + boundary_len  # --boundary--\n
    )
    return (
        content_length,
        lambda start, end: (
            f"--{boundary}\n"
            f"Content-Type: {content_type}\n"
            f"Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n"
            "\n"
        ).encode("latin-1"),
    )
